## Activity

During November 2024, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 131 captures. The activity record indicates that session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The reported volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results set out below. No additional operational issues are noted in the available report.

## Image quality

Of the captured images, 11 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 8.4. These images could not be used for grading, and the result should be considered alongside the total capture activity for the reporting period. The image-quality outcome identifies an area for routine monitoring in future sessions.

## Grading

Grading identified 20 referable results. The median lag from photograph to grade was 6 days. This provides the central measure of the time between image capture and completion of grading during November 2024. The results summarise the activity completed at Hill Counties Health Centre for the month and should be read with the image-quality findings.
